extracted.description: Compute the average elevation of the weather stations in the NOAA dataset, expressed in feet.
The average covers only the weather stations used for fire site monitoring.
Elevation inputs to the average must be valid and consistently handled.
The final answer must resolve the question as a reproducible single-value result in feet for the fire-monitoring station population.

stored.description: Compute the average elevation of the weather stations in the NOAA dataset, expressed in feet.
acceptanceCriteria: The result is a single numeric value equal to the arithmetic mean of the elevation values of the in-scope weather stations.
Elevation is expressed in feet; if source elevation is recorded in another unit (e.g., meters), values are converted to feet before averaging.

assertions.description: Compute the average elevation of the weather stations in the NOAA dataset, expressed in feet.

stored.description: The average covers only the weather stations used for fire site monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Only weather stations associated with fire site monitoring are included in the population being averaged.
Weather stations not used for fire site monitoring are excluded from the calculation.

assertions.description: The average covers only the weather stations used for fire site monitoring.

stored.description: Elevation inputs to the average must be valid and consistently handled.
acceptanceCriteria: Stations with missing or null elevation are excluded from the average, or handled by one explicitly stated and consistent rule.
Included elevation values fall within a physically plausible range for weather station elevations when expressed in feet.

assertions.description: Elevation inputs to the average must be valid and consistently handled.

stored.description: The final answer must resolve the question as a reproducible single-value result in feet for the fire-monitoring station population.
acceptanceCriteria: The answer reports exactly one average elevation value in feet for the fire site monitoring stations.
The reported value is reproducible when the same in-scope station set and averaging rule are reapplied.

assertions.description: The final answer must resolve the question as a reproducible single-value result in feet for the fire-monitoring station population.
